asset.name: dist-no-fonts.zip
asset.note: dist-no-fonts is used (not dist-cdn-fonts/dist) so the vendored static UI never references a runtime font CDN. Verified empirically against the pinned Mihomo v1.19.30 binary: Mihomo requires an external-ui directory to be a subpath of its own home directory or listed in the SAFE_PATHS environment variable of the process that spawns it, and otherwise attempts a live download of a dashboard from the internet -- this package must always stage this directory and set SAFE_PATHS before launching Mihomo. indexHtmlSha256 pins the exact unpatched upstream index.html the packaging scripts know how to CSP-patch; a future re-vendor must review and re-pin it deliberately.

dashboard.contentSecurityPolicy: default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' http://127.0.0.1:* ws://127.0.0.1:*; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self'; manifest-src 'self'; worker-src 'self'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; object-src 'none'
